governance: CANDIDATES ONLY — discovery is not trust. No row here is an active capability; each must pass the seeder's gap/lift screen, then human/eval gates, before any promotion. Source URLs are as reported; license/verify_note flags carried verbatim. serves_truth=false for everything downstream. Some general-purpose geo/weather entries (NASA Earth imagery, OpenAQ air quality, USGS streamflow/water, NOAA tides, FIRMS wildfires, satellite STAC download, raster NDVI/zonal-stats, marine/historical weather) were deliberately scoped OUT here because they are already in discovered-feed-geo-logistics-iot-2026-06-19.json — dedupe at intake. GBIF was NOT found in prior feeds (treated as net-new). Vegetation indices computed from imagery (NDVI/EVI) are model/sensor estimates, not ground truth — flag downstream.

candidates.intent: Query USDA NASS official agricultural estimates (crop yields, acreage, production, prices) by commodity, location, and year.
candidates.input_contract: a query of commodity + geographic level (national/state/county) + year/time period + statistic category
candidates.output_contract: official NASS survey/census estimates as structured records (value, unit, commodity, geography, year, source program)
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot recall county-level crop yields, planted acreage, or annual production estimates for specific years and fabricates plausible-but-wrong figures.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds the authoritative NASS programmatic interface returning real survey/census estimates with provenance, customizable by commodity/location/year.
candidates.verify_note: Free API key required after agreeing to NASS Terms of Service; JSON output ~39 columns; covers Census of Agriculture (every 5 yrs) + annual surveys. US-gov data is public domain.

candidates.intent: Retrieve USDA-published prices received by farmers for commodities over time and geography.
candidates.input_contract: a commodity + price statistic + geography + time period
candidates.output_contract: price-received records with value, unit, period, and geography
candidates.source_name: USDA NASS Quick Stats API (Agricultural Prices)
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Historical prices-received for specific commodities and months are precise published figures a model cannot reproduce.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds NASS Agricultural Prices retrieval returning real, dated price-received series via the Quick Stats backbone.
candidates.verify_note: Served by the same Quick Stats API/key as the statistics slot; the Agricultural Prices product is the price-received vertical. Dedupe with usda-nass-quickstats at intake if treated as one tool.

candidates.intent: Query USDA-NRCS SSURGO/Soil Data Access for tabular and spatial soil survey data via SQL over the REST/POST web service.
candidates.input_contract: a SQL query (or area-of-interest) against the Soil Data Mart (map units, components, horizons, properties)
candidates.output_contract: soil survey records (map unit, component, horizon, property values) as JSON/XML
candidates.gap_hypothesis: SSURGO map-unit keys, component fractions, and horizon-level soil properties are precise survey facts a model cannot enumerate or compute.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds SQL access to the authoritative US detailed soil survey, returning real map units and soil properties for any location.
candidates.verify_note: Requests via POST; output XML or JSON; 100,000-record / 32MB serialization limit per query. Requires valid SDA SQL; query-construction risk is the non-deterministic surface.

candidates.intent: Run a SSURGO interpretation/rating (e.g., crop suitability, erosion class) on a persistent area of interest via SDA.
candidates.input_contract: a defined area of interest plus an interpretation/rating name
candidates.output_contract: rating values per map unit for the requested interpretation
candidates.source_name: USDA-NRCS Soil Data Access (Post.Rest Interpretation Service)
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Soil interpretations are rule-based ratings computed over survey properties a model cannot reproduce reliably.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic NRCS interpretation/rating execution over a defined AOI returning official ratings.
candidates.verify_note: Uses the AOI Creation Service (pAOI) + Post.Rest Interpretation Service. Confirm exact rating names against SDA docs.

candidates.intent: Retrieve modeled global soil property estimates (pH, organic carbon, sand/silt/clay, CEC, nitrogen, bulk density) for a point or extent.
candidates.input_contract: latitude/longitude (or a small extent) plus desired soil properties and depth intervals
candidates.output_contract: predicted soil property values with uncertainty at six standard depths
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Global gridded soil properties at 250m are model outputs a bare LLM cannot produce for arbitrary coordinates.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds point/extent queries to SoilGrids returning 14 soil properties at six depths with quantified uncertainty worldwide.
candidates.verify_note: SoilGrids data CC-BY 4.0 (confirm wrapper license separately). v2.0 REST is BETA — no uptime guarantee; fair use ~5 calls/min. Values are ML predictions with uncertainty, NOT measured ground truth — flag downstream.

candidates.intent: Retrieve NASA POWER daily solar and meteorological parameters formatted for crop models (agroclimatology community).
candidates.input_contract: latitude/longitude + date range + parameter list + temporal resolution (daily/hourly/monthly)
candidates.output_contract: analysis-ready time series of solar/met parameters for the point and period
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Date- and location-specific solar irradiance, temperature, and precipitation estimates for crop modeling are values a model cannot recall or compute.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds NASA POWER agroclimatology retrieval returning real, dated, crop-model-ready solar/met parameters anywhere globally.
candidates.verify_note: No API key required; up to 20 parameters per single-point request; ~0.5x0.625deg met / 1x1deg solar resolution; Agroclimatology community formats parameters for crop models. Values are reanalysis/satellite estimates.

candidates.intent: Retrieve NASA POWER multi-year climatology normals (22-yr solar, 30-yr meteorology) for a point.
candidates.input_contract: latitude/longitude + parameter list + community
candidates.output_contract: period and monthly climatological averages (and min/max where available)
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Long-run climatological normals for an arbitrary location are computed aggregates a model cannot produce accurately.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds NASA POWER climatology normals (22-yr solar / 30-yr met) returning real monthly and period averages.
candidates.verify_note: Same POWER service family; Climatology microservice. No key required.

candidates.intent: Retrieve satellite-based evapotranspiration (ET) for a field/area at daily, monthly, or annual scale via OpenET.
candidates.input_contract: a geometry or field/area-of-interest + date range + temporal scale + ET model/ensemble selection
candidates.output_contract: ET values (mm) per period for the area, optionally per-pixel (30m), with model/ensemble identity
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Field-scale evapotranspiration is a satellite-derived computed quantity a model cannot estimate for specific fields and dates.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds OpenET access to quarter-acre-resolution ET (six models + ensemble) for irrigation scheduling and water accounting across the contiguous US.
candidates.verify_note: Built on Google Earth Engine + Landsat (30m pixels); daily/monthly/annual; CONUS coverage. ET is a model ensemble estimate, not measured truth. API key/registration likely; confirm license/quota on docs.

candidates.intent: Compute statistics (mean, stdev, histogram, percent cloudy) over satellite imagery for an area and time period without downloading images.
candidates.input_contract: area of interest + time range + evalscript (band math) + requested statistics
candidates.output_contract: JSON statistics (per band/index aggregates) for the AOI and period
candidates.source_name: Sentinel Hub Statistical API (Copernicus Data Space)
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Aggregate statistics over multi-temporal satellite imagery for a parcel are computations a model cannot perform without an imagery backend.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds server-side computation of band/index statistics over Sentinel/Landsat for any AOI and period, no image download.
candidates.verify_note: Requires Sentinel Hub / Copernicus Data Space account + OAuth client; evalscript defines the computation. Statistics are deterministic given inputs but rest on sensor/cloud data.

candidates.intent: Request processed satellite imagery (custom band combinations, indices, true/false color) for an AOI and date via evalscript.
candidates.input_contract: area of interest + time range + evalscript + output format/resolution
candidates.output_contract: a rendered raster (e.g., GeoTIFF/PNG) for the AOI and requested processing
candidates.source_name: Sentinel Hub Process API (Copernicus Data Space)
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot produce processed satellite raster outputs for arbitrary areas, dates, and band math.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds on-the-fly processing of Sentinel/Landsat imagery into custom indices/composites for an AOI via evalscript.
candidates.verify_note: Same Sentinel Hub auth as the Statistical API; output is imagery, not a fact — downstream interpretation needed.

candidates.intent: Search the Planetary Computer STAC catalog for Earth-observation assets by space, time, and collection.
candidates.input_contract: a STAC search (bbox/geometry + datetime + collection IDs + query filters)
candidates.output_contract: matching STAC items with asset hrefs and metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot enumerate which satellite scenes/assets exist for a given area, date, and dataset, nor their real asset URLs.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds STAC search over a petabyte-scale open EO catalog (Sentinel, Landsat, and many derived/weather datasets) returning real items and assets.
candidates.verify_note: STAC search is open; asset access may need a signing token (planetary-computer SDK). Distinct from the geo feed's generic STAC-download entry — this is the PC-hosted catalog specifically; dedupe at intake.

candidates.intent: Retrieve USDA Cropland Data Layer (CDL) crop classification for a location/area and compute crop statistics via CropScape web services.
candidates.input_contract: an area of interest (bbox/geometry/county) + year
candidates.output_contract: CDL crop-type classification raster and/or per-crop area statistics
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Which crop was grown on a given parcel in a given year (CDL classification) is a remote-sensing-derived fact a model cannot supply.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds CropScape geospatial services (ExtractCDLByValues, GetCDLStat, GetCDLComp) returning real crop classifications and statistics.
candidates.verify_note: CDL is a classified product (~30m) with known per-class accuracy; classification is a model estimate. Web services hosted at nassgeodata.gmu.edu; confirm exact service signatures.

candidates.intent: Retrieve satellite imagery and vegetation-index statistics (NDVI, EVI, NDWI, NRI, DSWI) for a registered field polygon.
candidates.input_contract: a registered polygon ID + date range (and image selection)
candidates.output_contract: available imagery references plus per-index statistics/history for the polygon
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Time-series vegetation-index values for a specific field are sensor-derived computations a model cannot produce.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds polygon-scoped Landsat-8/Sentinel-2 imagery + NDVI/EVI/NDWI/NRI/DSWI statistics and history for crop monitoring.
candidates.verify_note: Two-step API (search images, then fetch). API key required (OpenWeather/Agromonitoring). Vegetation indices are estimates; the geo feed's generic raster-NDVI entry is a library, this is a hosted field service — dedupe at intake.

candidates.intent: Retrieve accumulated temperature (growing degree days above a threshold) and accumulated precipitation for a field polygon over a period.
candidates.input_contract: a registered polygon ID + date range (unix) + temperature threshold
candidates.output_contract: accumulated temperature and accumulated precipitation series for the polygon
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Growing-degree-day and cumulative-precipitation totals for a field and period are computed aggregates a model cannot supply.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds polygon-scoped accumulated-temperature (thresholds 0/5/10/biological-min) and accumulated-precipitation endpoints for agronomic decisioning.
candidates.verify_note: Endpoints under api.agromonitoring.com/agro/1.0/weather/history/accumulated_*; API key + registered polygon required. Deterministic given the underlying weather series.

candidates.intent: Retrieve current and historical soil temperature and moisture at depth for a field polygon.
candidates.input_contract: a registered polygon ID (+ time for historical)
candidates.output_contract: soil temperature (surface/10cm) and soil moisture values for the polygon
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Field-level soil temperature and moisture are live/historical measurements a model cannot know.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds polygon-scoped current and historical soil temperature/moisture for irrigation and planting decisions.
candidates.verify_note: API key + registered polygon required. Soil values are modeled/observed estimates.

candidates.intent: Retrieve soil temperature/moisture at multiple depths and FAO-56 reference evapotranspiration from Open-Meteo, no API key.
candidates.input_contract: latitude/longitude + variable selection (soil_temperature_*, soil_moisture_*, et0_fao_evapotranspiration) + forecast/past horizon
candidates.output_contract: hourly/daily series of soil and ET variables for the location
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Multi-depth soil moisture/temperature and reference ET for a coordinate are computed/forecast fields a model cannot produce.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds key-free access to 60+ variables including multi-depth soil data and FAO-56 Penman-Monteith ET0 for irrigation scheduling.
candidates.verify_note: Free, no API key; Open-Meteo data is CC-BY 4.0 (non-commercial free tier — confirm commercial terms). Distinct from the geo feed's generic open-meteo-forecast entry by focusing on agronomic soil/ET variables — dedupe at intake.

candidates.intent: Retrieve ERA5 global reanalysis climate variables (atmospheric, land, ocean) from the Copernicus Climate Data Store.
candidates.input_contract: a CDS dataset name + request (variables, years/months/days/times, pressure levels, area)
candidates.output_contract: a data file (GRIB/NetCDF) of the requested reanalysis variables
candidates.source_name: Copernicus Climate Data Store (CDS) API / cdsapi
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Hourly historical climate fields from 1940-present are reanalysis outputs a model cannot reproduce for arbitrary variables and times.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds programmatic ERA5 retrieval (cdsapi) for hourly atmospheric/land/ocean climate variables back to 1940 worldwide.
candidates.verify_note: Requires CDS personal access token (~/.cdsapirc); licence acceptance per-dataset on CDS. Asynchronous queue; large downloads. ERA5 is reanalysis, not direct observation.

candidates.intent: Retrieve historical and CMIP6-projected climate variables and indices for countries/regions from the World Bank Climate Change Knowledge Portal.
candidates.input_contract: a geography (country/region) + collection (ERA5/CRU/CMIP6) + variable/index + scenario/period
candidates.output_contract: spatially aggregated climate statistics (historical or projected) for the geography
candidates.source_name: World Bank Climate Change Knowledge Portal (CCKP) API
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Country-level downscaled climate projections (70+ indices, multiple scenarios) are computed datasets a model cannot supply.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds CCKP access to historical (ERA5/CRU) and CMIP6-projected climate variables/indices aggregated by geography for climate-risk planning.
candidates.verify_note: Pre-computed stats via API or xls; also on AWS Open Data (s3://wbg-cckp). Projections are model scenarios, not certainties — flag downstream. Confirm exact API endpoints in CCKP metadata doc.

candidates.intent: Retrieve historical weather/climate observations and station metadata from NOAA NCEI Climate Data Online.
candidates.input_contract: a dataset + station/location + date range + data types
candidates.output_contract: observed climate records (e.g., GHCN daily temperature/precipitation) with station metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Station-level historical temperature/precipitation observations for specific dates are records a model cannot recall accurately.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds NCEI access to historical weather/climate observations and station histories returning real, dated records.
candidates.verify_note: Free token required (cdo-web/token); v2 endpoint deprecated in favor of access/services/data/v1 (5 req/s, 10k/day). US-gov public domain.

candidates.intent: Retrieve PRISM high-resolution US climate grids (daily/monthly/annual and 1991-2020 normals) for points or bulk.
candidates.input_contract: a point or set of points (up to 500) + variable (temp/precip/dewpoint) + temporal scale
candidates.output_contract: PRISM gridded climate values (e.g., max/min temp, precipitation, normals) for the locations
candidates.gap_hypothesis: High-resolution interpolated US climate values and 30-year normals for a point are gridded products a model cannot produce.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds PRISM time-series and 1991-2020 normals access (4km/800m) via web services for point and bulk queries.
candidates.verify_note: 800m time series free to public since Mar 2025 via FTP/web services; netCDF + BIL formats; Data Explorer bulk up to 500 points. Confirm attribution/license terms.

candidates.intent: Retrieve US Drought Monitor classifications (D0-D4) and area/population statistics by geography and week.
candidates.input_contract: a geography (national/state/county) + time period
candidates.output_contract: per-week drought-category statistics (percent area, total area, percent/total population) for the geography
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Weekly drought severity classifications and affected-area statistics are time-stamped facts a model cannot know after its cutoff.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds USDM statistics retrieval returning real D0-D4 area/population figures per geography and week.
candidates.verify_note: Statistics via USDM REST services + GIS files (shapefile/kmz/wms). Collaboration of NDMC/NOAA/USDA. US-gov public domain.

candidates.intent: Search GBIF biodiversity occurrence records by species, location, dataset, and date with paged or bulk download.
candidates.input_contract: occurrence filters (taxon key/name, country, geometry, date, basis-of-record)
candidates.output_contract: matching occurrence records with coordinates, taxonomy, dataset, and identifiers
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Specific species-occurrence records (where/when a taxon was observed) across 1.6B+ records are facts a model cannot enumerate.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds GBIF occurrence search + async bulk download returning real, georeferenced occurrence records with provenance.
candidates.verify_note: NOT found in prior feeds — net-new. Search APIs rate-limited (HTTP 429 -> use download API). Underlying datasets carry per-dataset licenses (CC0/CC-BY/CC-BY-NC) — citation/license handling required. Also on AWS Open Data + MS Planetary Computer.

candidates.intent: Resolve and look up scientific/vernacular names against the GBIF backbone taxonomy and retrieve taxon metadata.
candidates.input_contract: a scientific or common name (or taxon key)
candidates.output_contract: matched GBIF taxon with key, accepted name, rank, and classification
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Authoritative taxon keys, accepted names, and synonymy across the GBIF backbone are registry facts a model misattributes.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds GBIF name-matching to the backbone taxonomy returning real taxon keys and accepted classifications for downstream occurrence queries.
candidates.verify_note: Companion to the occurrence slot (taxon key feeds occurrence search). GBIF backbone is the de-facto standard taxonomy.

candidates.intent: Retrieve iNaturalist species observations filtered by taxon, place, date, and quality grade.
candidates.input_contract: observation filters (taxon id/name, iconic taxa, place, date range, quality grade)
candidates.output_contract: matching observations with coordinates, taxon, observer, and media references
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Citizen-science observation records for a taxon/place/date are live data a model cannot recall.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds iNaturalist v1 observation retrieval (incl. research-grade filtering and Darwin Core export) returning real georeferenced records.
candidates.verify_note: Read access broad; write needs OAuth. Observation media/data carry per-record licenses; coordinates may be obscured for sensitive taxa. Honor rate-limit recommended practices.

candidates.intent: Look up iNaturalist taxa and their hierarchy, common names, and identifiers.
candidates.input_contract: a taxon name or iNat taxon ID (optionally iconic taxa filter)
candidates.output_contract: taxon records with ancestry, common/scientific names, and IDs
candidates.gap_hypothesis: iNat-specific taxon IDs and hierarchy are registry facts a model cannot reproduce.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds iNat taxa lookup returning real taxon IDs and classification for filtering observations.
candidates.verify_note: Companion to the observations slot. Iconic-taxa enum supported (Plantae, Aves, Insecta, etc.).

candidates.intent: Fetch recent and notable bird observations from eBird for a region, hotspot, or species.
candidates.input_contract: a region/hotspot code (or lat/long + radius) + optional species + recency window
candidates.output_contract: recent observations with species, count, location, and date
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Recent bird sightings for a region or hotspot are live observations a model cannot know.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds eBird recent/notable observation retrieval returning real, dated sightings by region/hotspot/species.
candidates.verify_note: Personal API key required (x-ebirdapitoken header). Noncommercial use free/open; commercial use needs a written agreement — flag for jurisdiction/consumption gating. Designed for recent/summary outputs.

candidates.intent: Retrieve eBird region details, hotspot lists, and species checklists for a geography.
candidates.input_contract: a region code (or coordinates) + resource (hotspots / region info / species list)
candidates.output_contract: hotspot/region metadata or a species checklist for the geography
candidates.gap_hypothesis: eBird hotspot codes and regional species checklists are registry facts a model cannot enumerate.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds eBird hotspot/region/checklist retrieval returning real location codes and species lists.
candidates.verify_note: Same eBird key + commercial-use caveat as the observations slot.

candidates.intent: Query Global Forest Watch tree cover loss/gain and forest change statistics for a custom geometry or admin area.
candidates.input_contract: a geometry / admin boundary + dataset (tree cover loss/gain) + year range
candidates.output_contract: area of tree cover loss/gain (and related change metrics) for the geography
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Annual tree-cover-loss area for a specific region is a remote-sensing-derived statistic a model cannot supply.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds GFW geospatial queries returning real tree-cover-loss/gain statistics by custom geometry or admin boundary.
candidates.verify_note: GFW data free/open (WRI); REST returns JSON/GeoJSON. Loss/gain derived from satellite classification (Hansen/UMD) — estimates with known methodology. Confirm API key requirement and per-dataset terms.

candidates.intent: Retrieve near-real-time forest disturbance alerts (GLAD, RADD) for an area of interest from GFW.
candidates.input_contract: a geometry / admin boundary + alert system + date range
candidates.output_contract: forest disturbance alerts (location, date, confidence) for the AOI
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Near-real-time deforestation alerts are post-cutoff events a model cannot know.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds GFW GLAD/RADD alert retrieval returning real, dated forest-disturbance alerts for monitoring.
candidates.verify_note: Alerts are satellite-derived with confidence levels; methodology documented. Same GFW Data API as the loss slot.

candidates.intent: Search Climatiq's emission-factor database by activity, region, and dataset to find the right factor.
candidates.input_contract: an activity description / category + region + optional dataset/year filters
candidates.output_contract: matching emission factors with IDs, units, region, source dataset, and year
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Specific, source-attributed emission factors (kgCO2e per unit) across 140+ datasets are precise values a model cannot reliably recall or cite.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds search over 1M+ GHG-Protocol-compliant emission factors with IDs, units, regions, and source provenance.
candidates.verify_note: API key required; commercial product (free tier exists). Factors compliant with GHG Protocol, CO2e GWP100. Selecting the correct factor for an activity is the residual non-deterministic step.

candidates.intent: Estimate CO2e emissions for an activity by applying a chosen emission factor to an activity quantity.
candidates.input_contract: an emission factor selector (or activity id) + activity parameters (quantity, unit)
candidates.output_contract: computed CO2e (and gas breakdown) with the factor and method used
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Correctly multiplying an activity by the right emission factor with unit handling is an arithmetic-over-data task a model gets wrong.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic CO2e estimation given an activity and factor, with auditable factor identity and units.
candidates.verify_note: Computation deterministic given factor selection; the LLM-mapped factor choice (Autopilot) is NOT — keep factor selection auditable. API key required.

candidates.intent: Compute a product carbon footprint (PCF) from components, manufacturing location, and energy inputs.
candidates.input_contract: a JSON product spec (components, manufacturing location, energy inputs, transport)
candidates.output_contract: a CO2e result with lifecycle-stage breakdown and selected factors
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A full PCF requires factor selection, lifecycle-stage math, and transport emissions a model cannot do reproducibly.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds automated PCF computation handling factor selection, lifecycle stages, and transport, returning an auditable CO2e result.
candidates.verify_note: Component-to-factor mapping (esp. AI Autopilot) introduces non-determinism; PCFs are estimates requiring methodology disclosure. API key required.

candidates.intent: Retrieve hyperlocal real-time and historical air-quality (AQI, pollutants) for coordinates.
candidates.input_contract: latitude/longitude (+ time range for historical)
candidates.output_contract: air-quality values (AQI, PM2.5/PM10, pollutants) for the location
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Current/historical air-quality at a coordinate is live data a model cannot know.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds hyperlocal AQ data (US-EPA-aligned AQI + pollutants) for arbitrary coordinates, complementing station-only sources.
candidates.verify_note: Commercial API key required. Values modeled/blended from multiple channels (not pure ground-station). Distinct from the geo feed's OpenAQ entry (station-based) — dedupe at intake; flag overlap.

candidates.intent: Retrieve hyperlocal tree/grass/weed pollen counts and risk for coordinates, current and historical.
candidates.input_contract: latitude/longitude (+ period for historical)
candidates.output_contract: pollen counts/risk by category (tree, grass, weed) for the location
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Pollen counts by category for a location and date are live/measured data a model cannot recall.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds hyperlocal pollen (tree/grass/weed) current and historical data for health and agronomic use.
candidates.verify_note: Commercial API key required. Pollen values are modeled estimates. Health-adjacent — keep as data, not advice.

candidates.intent: Retrieve soil moisture and soil temperature for coordinates from Ambee.
candidates.input_contract: latitude/longitude (+ depth/time where supported)
candidates.output_contract: soil moisture and temperature values for the location
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Point soil moisture/temperature is a measured/modeled field a model cannot supply.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds coordinate-level soil moisture/temperature, an alternative to polygon-registration soil services.
candidates.verify_note: Commercial API key required. Modeled estimates. Overlaps Agromonitoring/Open-Meteo soil — dedupe at intake.

candidates.intent: Retrieve quality-assured EPA ambient air monitoring data (measurements, NAAQS averages, daily/annual summaries) by site, parameter, and date.
candidates.input_contract: a parameter code + geography (site/county/state) + date range + summary level
candidates.output_contract: air monitoring measurements or computed summaries with site/monitor metadata
candidates.source_name: EPA Air Quality System (AQS) Data Mart API
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Regulatory-grade historical air monitoring values and NAAQS averages for a monitor are precise records a model cannot reproduce.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds EPA AQS Data Mart access (~3.4B rows) returning quality-assured measurements and official summaries with full data dictionary.
candidates.verify_note: Free registration (email + key). AQS is the regulatory-grade, QA'd archive (distinct from preliminary AirNow). US-gov public domain. Synchronous + async Notify services.

candidates.intent: Retrieve real-time observed and forecast AQI for US locations from EPA AirNow.
candidates.input_contract: a location (zip/lat-long) + observed-or-forecast + date
candidates.output_contract: AQI values/categories by pollutant for the location
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Today's AQI and tomorrow's forecast for a city are live data a model cannot know.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds AirNow real-time observations (2,500+ monitors) and forecasts (500+ cities) returning current AQI by pollutant.
candidates.verify_note: Free account/key required. AirNow data is PRELIMINARY (not fully validated) per EPA guidelines — flag vs AQS. Covers US/Canada/Mexico. Distinct from AQS (QA'd) and OpenAQ — dedupe/flag overlap.

candidates.intent: Retrieve water-quality sample results (analytes, values, units) from the multi-agency Water Quality Portal (WQX + USGS).
candidates.input_contract: location/site + sampling/characteristic filters + date range
candidates.output_contract: sample results with characteristic, value, unit, method, and site metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Specific water-quality analyte measurements at a monitoring site are records a model cannot reproduce (430M+ records).
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds WQP web-service access to 430M+ results from 1,000+ programs (EPA WQX + USGS) with consistent filters and output.
candidates.verify_note: WQX3.0 standard now available (supersedes 1.0-2.2). No key required. US-gov public domain. Distinct from the geo feed's USGS-streamflow entry (flow, not chemistry) — dedupe at intake.

candidates.intent: Find water-quality monitoring stations/sites in the Water Quality Portal by location and program.
candidates.input_contract: location filters (bbox/state/county/HUC) + organization/site-type filters
